value: The next assignment is an escort through Moonbrook with the traitor leading the way to the hideout. The militia enters familiar Westfall ground now shadowed by the enemy’s presence. No individual adventurer is made the hero of a history they were never named in; the scene follows the objective and leaves the exact path open.
editorNote: Quest 155 supports the escort objective and hideout destination, not the exact path or a canonical player avatar.
